defect.reproducer: Branch pr04-defect, one commit (evidence/pr04/defect.patch): check_value returns None for publish_hz, so the frequency check is disabled. With turtlesim and patrol running, ros2 param set /patrol publish_hz 5.0 still works, but ros2 param set /patrol publish_hz 0.0 gets no reply and is cut by timeout (exit 124); the patrol process exits with code 1 and ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero in Settings.period_sec while the post-set callback recreates the timer; /turtle1/cmd_vel has Publisher count: 0 and ros2 topic hz shows no messages. The same pytest tests fail on this branch (evidence/pr04/tests.txt, logs/tests-defect.txt, logs/defect/4-set-0.txt).
defect.root_cause: Without the check, 0.0 is written to the parameter and the post-set callback recreates the timer with period 1.0 / publish_hz. The division raises inside the set_parameters service handler, the exception propagates into rclpy.spin, so the service reply is never sent and the node process terminates. Negative and NaN rates break timer creation the same way.
defect.proof_after: On main the check runs in add_on_set_parameters_callback before the value is stored: ros2 param set /patrol publish_hz 0.0 returns Setting parameter failed with the reason, ros2 param get still shows 5.0, ros2 topic hz still shows about 5 Hz and patrol keeps running; -2.0, .nan and 31.0 are rejected the same way. The tests that failed on pr04-defect pass on main, including the pure-function cases for 10 -> 5 Hz, zero, negative and NaN (evidence/pr04/parameters.md, tests.txt).
